title: Briarheart Necropsy
description: Neloth asks the player to examine a Forsworn Briarheart warrior to learn how their hearts are replaced with briar seeds, casting a memory trace spell to record observations. The player must travel to The Reach, kill and harvest a Briarheart, then return to Neloth for a 250 gold reward.

base_facts: I am a Telvanni wizard conducting heart stone experiments at Tel Mithryn.
All my test subjects in heart replacement experiments have died.
Forsworn Briarhearts replace their hearts with large briar seeds, connecting their lifesparks to natural forces.
I can cast a memory trace spell to record someone's observations without them needing to take notes.

ACCEPT_QUEST: I have sent the player to The Reach to examine a Briarheart warrior and cast my memory spell on them.
EXAMINE_BRIARHEART: The player has examined a Briarheart and seen how the heart was implanted. I await their return.
REPORT_TO_NELOTH: I have extracted the player's memories of the Briarheart examination and paid them 250 gold for their efforts.
Player returns to Neloth at Tel Mithryn; he extracts memories and pays 250 gold.
Return to Neloth for your reward.
It puts their lifesparks in direct connection to the natural forces.

beats.comment: Player talks to Neloth about his research and agrees to examine a Briarheart.
Player kills a Forsworn Briarheart in The Reach and harvests the heart.
Player returns to Neloth at Tel Mithryn; he extracts memories and pays 250 gold.
